subject: NeedlePoint sandbox: runway top-off request & discount escrow
messages:
From: Asha Kapoor <asha@needlepoint.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@needlepoint.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox runway top-off request

Hey Soojin,

Quick note from our side — the engineering team burned through the sandbox hours faster than expected while testing the embedding latency improvements. We're ~60% through the original 30-day sandbox after only 18 days. Can we top off the sandbox for an additional 10 days (same environment, no model changes) while we finish the integration?

Two constraints from procurement: (1) we can't sign a long-term commitment today, so a short top-off or credit bucket is preferred; (2) finance asks whether there is a small one-time discount or escrow mechanism if we commit to a short conversion timeline (we expect to convert to paid Dedicated in ~6 weeks pending a scale test).

If easier, I can take a call with you and procurement this afternoon.

Thanks,
Asha
Asha Kapoor
Head of ML Platform, NeedlePoint Labs
asha@needlepoint.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0126

--
Attachment: NP_usage_report_Q1.csv (CSV, 38KB)

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@needlepoint.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway top-off request

On Fri, 16 Apr 2027 at 09:12, Asha Kapoor <asha@needlepoint.ai> wrote:
> Quick note from our side — the engineering team burned through the sandbox hours faster than expected...

Hi Asha — thanks for the heads-up and the usage report. We can do a short runway top-off while preserving the sandbox config. Two pragmatic options that usually work for accounts in this stage: 

1) Time extension: add 10 calendar days to the existing sandbox window (no extra billing) as a one-off courtesy.

2) Credit top-up with escrow/convertibility: purchase a small bucket of credits today at a ~10% discount, placed in escrow and fully convertible to Dedicated credits if you convert within 8 weeks. If you don't convert, credits remain usable on the hosted API for 12 months.

Operational notes: the credit-escrow option lets us reserve burst capacity (we can pin a small dedicated slice during your scale test) and gives procurement a commercial commitment without a long-term term.

If procurement wants a discount tied to a conversion milestone, we can propose a 7% staged rebate on the bucket (pay now, 7% refunded if you sign a Dedicated MSA within 45 days). Legal will need to review the escrow/redemption language.

Next steps: I can (a) apply the 10-day top-off immediately, or (b) send a short SOW and invoice for the escrowed credits + the conversion rebate language for legal. Which do you prefer?

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call; I'm free today 2–4pm PT.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
LinkedIn: /soojin-lee

--
Attachment: none

From: Asha Kapoor <asha@needlepoint.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@needlepoint.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway top-off request

Thanks — appreciate the quick options, Soojin. Procurement leans toward the escrowed credits because it creates a clean path to convert without a PO delay. A few clarifying Qs from finance: 

• Can the bucket be invoiced as a single prepaid line item and then flagged as escrow in the invoice text?
• Will the staged rebate (7%) be processed automatically or requires a refund/credit note once the MSA signs?
• Can you include a modest engineering-hours buffer (4 hours) to help with any integration regressions we hit during the scale test?

If you can send over the short SOW + invoice draft we can route to our legal & procurement for a quick review. We aim to complete the conversion (if all goes well) within 6 weeks.

I can take a call today at 3pm PT if that helps — happy to confirm after procurement reviews the draft.

Asha

--
Attachment: NP_usage_report_Q1.csv referenced

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Asha Kapoor <asha@needlepoint.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai, billing@needlepoint.ai
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sandbox runway top-off request

Asha — looping in Kim (contracts/finance) and Priyom (solutions) to expedite.

Per our call earlier today, attached is a short SOW that implements option (2):
- 5K token-equivalent credit bucket (prepaid) invoiced as a single line, marked in the invoice and SOW as "escrowed credits"
- Conversion rebate: 7% refund issued as a credit note within 10 business days of a fully executed Dedicated MSA (MSA must reference deal ID NDLP-20270416)
- Engineering buffer: 4 hours of Redwood SE time to join your scale test (applied as timezone-blocked support hours in the SOW)
- Expiry: credits usable on the account for 12 months if no conversion; escrow releases to your billing pool on conversion.

Kim — can finance prepare the draft invoice and the short SOW as attached? Priyom — can you confirm the SE resource availability the week of Apr 26 for a 2-hour ramp session + on-call for the scale test?

If procurement approves the invoice language, we'll invoice the bucket as a prepaid line and mark the credit note to be applied automatically when MSA executes (we'll chase the MSA reference).

Attachments: NeedlePoint_SOW_draft.pdf, NP_usage_report_Q1.csv

Thanks — I think this gets procurement across the finish line without forcing a long-term commitment.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
